latest.title: Daily Background Version Polling & Focus Sync
latest.summary: Added 24-hour background polling and window-focus synchronization so users with always-open applications receive new version notifications without restarting.

highlights.title: Daily Version Polling
highlights.description: Automatically polls for new application releases in the background every 24 hours.

highlights.title: Window Focus Sync
highlights.description: Silently checks for updates when the window regains focus if more than 24 hours have elapsed.
